name: MailAutomations
technicalDescription: Scheduled outbound mail runs (component 04, tab אוטומציות). Today one row: the monthly open-debts mail (replaces AgentSettings.openDebtsDay and the daily OpenDebtsBatch). The hourly MailAutomationsRunner workflow runs an active automation once its dayOfMonth and hour have arrived and it has not run this month. Every run writes drafts to Approvals (component מנה חודשית) and a MailAutomationRuns row. Nothing is sent. Templates use {{customerName}}, {{customerCode}}, {{contactName}}, {{asOfDate}}, {{month}}, {{openTotal}}, {{bookkeeperName}}, {{bookkeeperPhone}}.
